exploratoryNote: This result is exploratory (the report labels it so).
intro: A neural network and tuned tree models were trained and scored on measured corrosion rates (point values from NIST CORR-DATA). Scores come from cross-validation in which whole groups of related rows are held out together (5 repeats of the network). Lower error is better.

tasks.name: Corrosion rate
tasks.single: One network at a time: clearly better than the trees in 0 of 5 runs.
